description: Wispr Flow parity corpus for sentence trimming and word removal. Cases tagged wispr-doc are the documented examples from Wispr's help center (docs.wisprflow.ai, 'How do I use Smart Formatting & Backtrack'). The rest encode the documented rules: Backtrack keeps the sentence frame and replaces only what was corrected; non-corrective uses of trigger words survive; fillers, stutters and false starts go; word choice and phrasing are never changed. Graded on normalized match (words), since Wispr's own examples are inconsistent about the final full stop.

cases.input: let's do coffee at 2 actually 3
cases.note: Documented Backtrack example. The frame 'Let's do coffee at' survives; only the corrected slot is replaced.

cases.input: I wanted to buy a record as a gift as a present
cases.expected: I wanted to buy a record as a present.
cases.note: Documented natural-restatement example: no trigger word, the speaker just says it again differently.

cases.input: I actually enjoyed the movie
let's meet tuesday wait no friday
can we meet tuesday at five or actually make it friday at three
cases.expected: Can we meet Friday at three?
cases.note: Regression: the model used to return 'Make it Friday at three', throwing away the frame. Wispr keeps the frame and swaps the slot.

cases.input: the meeting is on the fifth I mean the sixth
cases.expected: The meeting is on the sixth.

cases.input: send it to john scratch that send it to sarah
can you grab milk on the way never mind I'll get it
sorry for the late reply I was out all day
cases.expected: Sorry for the late reply, I was out all day.
cases.note: 'sorry' as an apology is not a correction.

cases.input: no I don't think that works
cases.expected: No, I don't think that works.

cases.input: wait for me at the entrance
cases.expected: Wait for me at the entrance.

cases.input: um so we should uh ship it tomorrow
cases.expected: So we should ship it tomorrow.

cases.input: it was like really slow
cases.note: 'like' as a filler with no comma around it. The rules pass only removes soft fillers in comma position, so this is the model's job.

cases.input: I like the new design
the build is you know flaky
you know the answer already
cases.note: 'you know' as subject + verb. A naive hard-filler rule deletes this and leaves 'The answer already.'

cases.input: I mean it this time
I I think we we should go
I was going to I'm going to call him tomorrow
cases.expected: I'm going to call him tomorrow.

cases.input: can we can we move the standup
gonna grab lunch then head back
cases.expected: Gonna grab lunch, then head back.
cases.note: Wispr does not change word choice. 'gonna' must not become 'going to'.

cases.input: the results were kinda meh honestly
cases.expected: The results were kinda meh, honestly.

cases.input: um so the demo is on thursday uh actually no wednesday and uh we need the slides by like tuesday
cases.expected: So the demo is on Wednesday and we need the slides by Tuesday.
